title: Tenure is measured with noise
trigger: no check from the data alone — needs a gold-standard comparison
headsup: tenure_months as recorded (derived from a first-invoice date) disagrees with true tenure by about a standard deviation. Classical measurement error attenuates the coefficient toward zero: the tenure effect came out 70% too small, and the report would rank it below factors it actually beats.
mitigation: Validate derived fields against a source of truth on a sample; if noise is known, correct for attenuation or say the effect is a lower bound.
